newsitem.title: CHINA: China's bicycle demand seen up to 32 mln in 1997.
newsitem.headline: China's bicycle demand seen up to 32 mln in 1997.

text.p: China was expected to see a rise in demand for bicycles in 1997 to 32 million due to an increase in exports, the People's Daily Overseas Edition said on Monday.
Last year, production and sales of bicycles declined, mainly because of a fall in exports, while imports rose, it said. It did not give comparative figures.
In 1996, China produced fewer than 30 million bicycles, down 20 percent from 1995, the newspaper said.
